title: THE AIR STRIKE NAMES YOUR KEYS
why: Found in the cloud hunt of 2026-10-15: the air strike prompts were written out by hand, so they ignored rebinding. The key half was fixed earlier (v27.43); on a controller, with CHANGE PAD BUTTONS moving previous gun to Y, the chord is really Y and RB, but the ready plate, the aim line and AIR STRIKE READY still said LB + RB. The three prompts now read the buttons as set; on the defaults they read exactly as before.
now: The air strike prompts name the controller buttons you set, not always LB + RB.

edits.replacement: (padOn()?padB(pbn(4)+' + '+pbn(5)):keyLabel('KeyG','G'))+' CANCEL',s.x,s.y-ar-U(8));   // v28.xx (cloud-menus-air-strike-keys), CLOUD HUNT 2026-10-15: the cancel names the buttons as set (previous gun moved to Y says Y + RB)

function airCapLabel(){ return padOn()?padB(pbn(4)+'+'+pbn(5)):keyLabel('KeyG','G'); }   // v28.xx (cloud-menus-air-strike-keys), CLOUD HUNT 2026-10-15: the chord reads the buttons after CHANGE PAD BUTTONS; the keyboard half was fixed at v27.43
